name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default. It skips past repetitive navigation straight to main content, solving keyboard users’ biggest pain point. Trade-off: it takes up a little space, but the clarity for screen-reader and keyboard users outweighs the visual cost.

name: Reader
text: A visible skip link risks pushing down primary content below the fold on small screens, making it harder for *all* users—not just keyboard users—to reach key information quickly. A hidden skip link with keyboard focus (like `position: absolute; left: -9999px;`) solves the problem without layout shifts, but only if we test with real screen-reader users to confirm they discover it. Settle it with a live usability test: measure time-to-task for keyboard users on both versions.
